name: Omenpath
description: Omenpaths are planar portals, originally created by Kaldheim's World Tree and later by New Phyrexia's Invasion Tree, that are now the main way to travel between planes.

summary.text: Omenpaths are planar portals, originally created by Kaldheim's World Tree and later by New Phyrexia's Invasion Tree, that are now the main way to travel between planes.

bio.text: On Kaldheim they were random ways between worlds that opened and closed, with many at once signaling a Doomskar, and Niko Aris used one to reach Starnheim and to herd Koma back out.

timeline.summary: Spitfire emerges through an Omenpath onto Amonkhet to find the Speed Demons took first place and she is second.
timeline.quote: And Spitfire realizes it's not her.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: An Omenpath opens at the end of the Amonkhet track, leading to Muraganda.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Following Loot's cue, Chandra steers left into a tree whose bark falls away to reveal an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Beneath it, the spiraling light of an Omenpath.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset and Elspeth find an Omenpath in a subterranean antechamber and step through.
timeline.quote: Nothing to do but step through, then,

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 5: Recursion" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Elspeth carries Narset and Loot through the Omenpath into the temple, where Vraska takes Loot.
timeline.quote: they were on the other side: outside the temple, Elspeth in the air, Vraska somehow beside her, arms held out for Loot.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: The spreading darkness washes over and erases the Omenpath, and Abigale flies up to confirm it is gone.
timeline.quote: it washed over the iridescent triangle, seemingly wiping it away.

timeline.summary: Four Strixhaven students are led astray by a mysterious faerie and fall through an Omenpath onto Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, disturbing the balance between its two aspects.
timeline.quote: Four Strixhaven students are led astray by a mysterious faerie , and fall through an Omenpath onto the plane of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Debt, enemies and a failed robbery leave the group poor; Shadress dies and Yuma flees through an Omenpath with the last money.
timeline.quote: Yuma abandoned the group with the last of its funds

citation.text: "Elnor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elnor follows through the Omenpath to Thunder Junction and confronts Yuma at his bar with fire.
timeline.quote: She entered Yuma 's bar with fire literally in her hands
